tls_server_name.description: tls only: the reviewed DNS name on the server certificate (SNI and verification; never resolved).

tls_ca_file.description: tls only: a work/... PEM file with the owner's private CA certificate.

approved_destinations.description: Optional. The dial strings the owner approved for this target (the scope's destinations[].user); `scope compile` writes it. When present, call and matrix refuse any other --dial before anything is sent; an empty list approves no destination. When absent, the profile does not restrict the destination.

security_checks.description: Optional. The owner-approved security posture checks (approved, max_requests, account, destination, cleartext_endpoints); see docs/SECURITY-CHECKS.md. rehearse validates it against the reviewed catalog, and refuses a destination that is not in target.approved_destinations when the profile carries that list.

media.description: Optional. What the owner approved for media; at least one field. codecs: calls offer only these, and a requested codec outside the list is refused. networks: owner-approved media networks, MEDIA ONLY (they admit a negotiated media peer, never a signaling target; target.host must still be a literal approved address); rehearse refuses host bits, a network of more than 1024 addresses (IPv4 wider than /22, IPv6 wider than /118), more than 1024 addresses in total, more than 16 networks, and unspecified, multicast, reserved, or broadcast ranges. port_range: the far end's approved RTP ports; a negotiated media port outside it stops the call. addresses: the owner's media answer, its single addresses (written by scope compile); when present, media is admitted only at these and in networks, even at the signaling address; each must be a literal approved address.

items.description: CIDR network with no host bits set, for example 198.51.100.0/27
a literal IP address in canonical form, also in target.approved_addresses
